decision.reason: [ev-bede4495e31b] is only a one-line changelog title. It says that regexp is now supported in Path/PathPrefix under "matcher v2", and it points to PR #10546, which is not shown. It does not say how these matchers behaved before, which rule syntax or configurations are affected, or what happens to an operator who does nothing. The surrounding Bug fixes section ([ev-7cea1050ccfe] and the other entries) gives no further detail, and no upgrade-guide section is shown. That leaves applicability and consequence impossible to state.
